name: canvas
description: Read open projects, node text, connections, and available agent definitions from the local Canvas desktop app.

interface.longDescription: Explore open projects in Canvas: read node text previews and connections, and inspect the available agent definitions. Canvas must be running on the same Windows computer with MCP enabled. This connection is read-only: it cannot edit projects, execute agents, generate content, or return complete image, video, or document files. The package connects to the default local endpoint; setup explains how to connect an existing custom profile.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the active project in Canvas.
Explain the connections between nodes in my Canvas project.
Which agent definitions are available in Canvas?
